title: Austin: Pensions, Security, and Oversight Update
meeting_type: Audit and Finance Committee Regular Meeting
summary:
*   Receive updates on the financial health of retirement systems for city employees, including police and firefighters.
*   Get a closed-door briefing on the city's information security management and recent audit findings.
*   Review the proposed audit plan for the upcoming fiscal year, detailing future financial scrutiny.
